headline: Worth Peripherals confirms SEBI demat compliance for the September quarter
hook: Procedural demat compliance filed for Worth Peripherals
summary: Worth Peripherals has submitted its confirmation regarding SEBI demat compliance for the September quarter. The filing is a standard regulatory requirement for listed entities. Indian retail investors generally view this as routine administrative disclosure with no direct impact on stock price or business operations.
why_it_matters: Routine regulatory filing with no material impact on financials.
